name: ai-weekly
description: AI 周报 —— 采访式个人周复盘工具（状态打分卡 · 按打分追问低分项 · 跳过没感觉的题 · 成长 · 三档深度 · 一周两次接着补）
author: AI 周报

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run check:dist && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run check:dist && electron-builder --win
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.measure:memory: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/measure-memory.mjs
scripts.measure:memory:walk: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/measure-memory.mjs --walk 6
scripts.verify:skip: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/measure-memory.mjs --skip 3
scripts.verify:result: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/measure-memory.mjs --result
